tutorial.title: Styling Groups of Elements
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to style groups of elements into different sections on your webpage.

lessons.title: Separate
lessons.interactiveContent: Let's learn how to style groups of elements on a webpage with the help of <div> elements.

lessons.title: Div
lessons.interactiveContent:
Group these elements inside a <div> element to get started.

Make sure to pick <div>, followed by </div>.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A <div> groups related elements. Use that element to put the heading and description in one group.

Make sure to pick <div>, followed by </div>.

lessons.title: Div selector
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can style the group of elements we created, using div as a tag selector.

Make sure to type div.

lessons.title: Div color
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can add other properties to style the group of elements. For example, setting background-color to bisque.

Make sure to pick background-color followed by : and then bisque, ;.
lessons.hardModeContent:
We can add properties to style a group of elements. Give the div the bisque background shown here.

Make sure to pick background-color, followed by :, bisque, and finally ;.

lessons.title: Div margin
lessons.interactiveContent:
To improve spacing inside and outside of the group of elements, we can add margins and padding. Like margin: 20px;.

Make sure to pick margin followed by : and then 20px, ;.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Margins add space outside a group. Add 20px of outside space around this div.

Make sure to pick margin, followed by :, 20px, and finally ;.

lessons.title: Question: Div
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are <div> elements used for?

To group elements togetherTo link to other webpages

To group elements together.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You place a heading and a paragraph between one pair of div tags. Which elements belong to that group?

Both the heading and the paragraphOnly the headingOnly the paragraph

Both the heading and the paragraph.

lessons.title: Question: Div selector
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which one of these is a tag selector?

divstyle

Make sure to pick div.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You want a CSS rule to target every <div> element by its tag name. Which selector begins that rule?

divstyle<div>

Make sure to pick div.

lessons.title: Question: Div color
lessons.interactiveContent:
What do we use div selectors for?

To style groups of elementsTo create new elements

To style groups of elements.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A page has several <div> groups that need the same CSS rule. What is a div selector for?

Style groups of elementsCreate new elementsAdd links to a group

Make sure to pick Style groups of elements.

lessons.title: Question: Div margin
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does this code do?

It sets a 40px margin around <div> elementsIt sets a 30px margin around <p> elements

It sets a 40px margin around <div> elements.
lessons.hardModeContent:
In the copied CSS, which elements receive 40px of outside space on all sides?

Every <div> elementEvery <p> elementOnly the heading inside the div

Make sure to pick Every <div> element.

lessons.title: Example: Div
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add a <div> element around the <h3> and the <img> elements.

Make sure to pick < followed by div and then >, </, div, >.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use a <div> to group the product name, image, and price.

Make sure to pick <, followed by div, >, </, div, and finally >.

lessons.title: Example: Div selector
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set div as the tag selector for this rule.

Make sure to type div.

lessons.title: Example: Div color
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the navigation of this webpage stand out by setting the background color for the <div> element.

Make sure to pick background-color followed by : and then burlywood, ;.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Give the navigation div the burlywood background, without changing its links.

Make sure to pick background-color, followed by :, burlywood, and finally ;.

lessons.title: Example: Div margin
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add the selectors so that the <div> element has values set for the margins and padding.

Make sure to pick div, followed by p.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Apply the first rule to the navigation group itself. Apply the italic rule only to the copyright paragraph.
